name: Kazoo
group: Things people make > Toys > Make music with it > Blow into it

features.claim: A kazoo is a tube with a circular hole that is raised above the length of the tube.
features.quote: Frost's kazoo did not have the streamlined, submarine shape of modern kazoos, but it was similar in that the aperture was circular and elevated above the length of the tube.

features.claim: The player hums into the wider and flattened side of the kazoo.
features.quote: A kazoo player hums, rather than blows, into the wider and flattened side of the instrument.

second_reading.claim: A kazoo has a membrane that vibrates when the player hums into it.
second_reading.quote: The oscillating air pressure of the hum makes the kazoo's membrane vibrate.

second_reading.claim: The membrane is made of goldbeater's skin or a material with similar characteristics.
second_reading.quote: one of a class of instruments that modify the player's voice by way of a vibrating membrane of goldbeater's skin or material with similar characteristics

second_reading.claim: The first metal kazoo, the modern one, was made of metal.
second_reading.quote: The modern kazoo—also the first one made of metal—was patented by George D. Smith of Buffalo, New York,  May 27, 1902.
